intro.title: Cozy Nest
intro.welcome: We are happy to have you with us. Use this guest guide for everything you need during your stay — hotel information, dining times, activities, transport and local recommendations.
intro.about: A modern and comfortable guest house in the heart of Fuvahmulah, offering warm Maldivian hospitality, stylish rooms and easy access to the island's top attractions and world-famous dive sites.

diving.title: Dive Fuvahmulah
diving.description: World-famous tiger shark and reef encounters await, just minutes from the hotel with our dive partner, Cozy Scuba Club.

guestInfo.currency: The local currency is the Maldivian rufiyaa (MVR). Guest payments at our hotel are handled in US dollars. Please contact reception with any currency questions.
guestInfo.localTime: Maldives time is GMT+5 (UTC+5) throughout the year, with no daylight saving time. Fuvahmulah follows the same time as the capital, Malé.
guestInfo.payment: Payments are handled between 21:00 and 22:00. We accept Mastercard, Visa, American Express and UnionPay credit/debit cards, bank transfers and online payments.
guestInfo.roomKey: Please keep your room key in a safe place. Lost or damaged keys are charged to your account at US$65. Return your key to reception 15 minutes before departure.
guestInfo.clothing: Casual clothing is welcome. Please respect local customs when exploring inhabited islands by covering your shoulders and thighs. Swimwear is not permitted in the restaurant, bar or office areas; a T-shirt and shorts are recommended.
guestInfo.laundry: Laundry service is available. Please contact your room attendant or reception for assistance.
guestInfo.scubaSchool: Contact Cozy Scuba Club for diving courses, availability and bookings. Reception can help you get in touch with the team.
guestInfo.excursions: Explore the Maldives with island hopping, night fishing, a sunset cruise or deep-sea fishing. Ask reception about available excursions and arrangements.
guestInfo.propertyDamage: Damage to hotel property or missing items will be charged to your account according to their value in US dollars.
guestInfo.tips: Tipping is customary in the Maldives. If you would like to thank a particular staff member, we recommend giving your tip directly to them.
